name: Contextual Relevance
description: Measure of how well the generated continuation aligns with the provided context and maintains a consistent topic throughout the conversation.

name: Fluency
description: Assessment of the grammatical correctness, coherence, and readability of the generated continuation, considering factors such as sentence structure, punctuation, and word usage.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluation of the generated continuation's ability to stimulate further conversation, considering factors such as the use of open-ended questions, personal anecdotes, and interesting facts.

name: Creativity
description: Measure of the originality, uniqueness, and imaginative elements in the generated continuation, considering factors such as novel ideas, humor, and unexpected twists.

name: Fact Accuracy
description: Assessment of the factual correctness of the information presented in the generated continuation, considering the context and the provided interesting fact.
